chunk_map.heading: H1/lede: Map the gaps, author the skill
Phase 1: Diff the two runs, rank the gaps
Read the contrast, push back where it generalises
Cut one stale rule the diagnosis killed
Say go, unless the cut spreads past the one rule
Phase 2: Find the work you repeat across your stack
Scan your history for the work that recurs
Draw your top work-shapes as diagrams
List the checks the field runs, rank the ones that fit your gap
Pick the skill shape the diff points at
Critique the draft before you ship it
Invoke the skill on the run you just diffed
Ship it to your personal kit

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
Live-demo beats survive a text read.
Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 6 "Scan your history for the work that recurs": line 80: "**Fast operator?**" (2-word handle, compliant alone) plus line 82: "**This scan runs long, and it is yours to steer.**" (10-word full lead sentence bolded) — two separate bolded blockquote leads in one chunk breach the "≤1 bolded element on most slides" budget, and line 82 independently bolds a whole lead sentence rather than a ≲5-word handle sub-span. chunk 7 "Draw your top work-shapes as diagrams": line 115: "**Want to see the shapes, not read them?**" (8-word full-sentence question bolded, not a handle). chunk 10 "Author the skill in conversation": line 150: "**Skip the critique and the testing if you want.**" (9-word full lead sentence bolded, not a handle). This is the pre-2026-07-09 monoculture shape the emphasis pass targeted; the maintainer note at line 215 says blockquote callouts were deliberately left untouched by that pass and explicitly flags "re-audit before ship" — these three are what that re-audit catches. (Chunk 9's three bolded shape-name handles — Sharpened verifier / LLM-judge / Gap-finder — are the compendium's own named exception: a consolidation slide listing named forms may carry one handle per form; not flagged.)
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: De-bold each blockquote lead to plain prose, or shrink it to a ≲5-word handle; keep at most one bolded element per chunk (chunk 6 currently has two).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
